item.title: Bulletin updated at 18:50 HKT 23/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure now over the northern part of the South China Sea will edge closer to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the region. The area of low pressure near Hainan Island has a higher chance to move towards the coast of the western part of southern China. Meanwhile, the northeast monsoon now affecting southern China will moderate gradually. With the trough of low pressure weakening and the gradual strengthening of an anticyclone aloft, showers will ease off and it will be brighter over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. High temperatures will also trigger showers over inland areas. An easterly airstream is expected to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong during the weekend. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will affect southern China early to midweek next week.
